description: In a complete consistent Henkin set \(U\), every term \(t\) with auxiliary names is equal according to \(U\) to some auxiliary name \(n\in\mathbb N\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.JointConsistency.every_term_named.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {U : Set (L.Formula ℕ)}
  (hU : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent U)
  (hC : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.Complete U)
  (hH : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.Henkin U) (t : L.Term ℕ) :
  ∃ n, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.TermEquivalent U t (FirstOrder.Language.var n)
